findings.title: Pointer update substitutes clipped hit width for the logical wrapped layout width
findings.evidence: The registered Part::TEXT rectangle is clipped by the runtime. update_lines now builds LayoutKey from its visible width, while draw_lines/rows wrap using the full logical text width. A real public Runtime consumer uses logical viewport Rect(0,0,24,4), clip Rect(0,0,10,4), wrap(true), and line "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv WORD". It confirms W is visibly rendered at (2,1), then presses/releases there. Exact pre2624cc selects WORD at CellPos(0,23)..(0,27);795 selects the preceding identifier at CellPos(0,0)..(0,22). Same consumer source, different manifests and revision-specific Cargo targets. Draw wraps at22 columns while update reconstructs rows at clipped Part::TEXT width9.
findings.repair: Keep logical text geometry and wrapping width from the committed resolved layout separate from the visible hit/clipping rectangle. Pointer mapping must use the same visual-row layout as drawing, with the appropriate visible origin, not rebuild wrapping from clipped hit width. Add this exact clipped wrapped regression and left/top/right-clipping/resize cases.

reviewed_repairs.R3: The inert horizontal scrollbar path and conditional row/width reservation are removed. Default reserve_gutter=true/scroll_gap=0 retains width.saturating_sub(2), all area rows, and preferred82-column width, matching the pre262 source formulas.
reviewed_repairs.R6: Gutterless horizontal origin correction is present and native runtime word-selection regression passes across all four profiles. The clipped wrapped geometry change introduces VP795-R1 above.
reviewed_repairs.R7: Reserved-width and preferred-size arithmetic now use saturating u16 operations. Native maximum-gap measurement/update/draw cases pass, including zero/narrow bounds.
reviewed_repairs.R8: Unconditional widest_line scan is removed entirely; the existing generation-aware layout cache remains. Native incremental-work and large data tests pass. No independent benchmark or full content-read instrumentation was added by this review.
reviewed_repairs.API: reserve_gutter,scroll_gap,bar_cursor remain additive builders; ViewportState public API preserved. No horizontal scrolling completeness is claimed. No new unsafe code or concurrency mechanism found.
reviewed_repairs.resize: The existing real-runtime resize publication test passes in the56-test scope. No new stale-before-presentation dispatch regression was identified; this does not fix the clipped wrapping mismatch.

coverage_limits: Review stopped acceptance at the demonstrated new clipping regression; complete lossless default frame/hit/cursor equivalence to pre262 across all data/profiles was not established.
Native checks include all four profile caret/width tests and existing scrolling fade oracle, but these are not a complete frozen application comparison.
No paired Tuiscotti real CLI captures, full workspace gate, hosted CI result or application/TerminalView adoption verified.
Unrelated incoming commits, menu changes and application repaint/replay paths are outside this source repair approval.
workspace_integrity: Detached sparse copies at exact795 and4cc, separate revision targets, identical external consumer source, explicit bounded process groups under220s, all owned commands reaped. No product edits, commits, pushes or expected-reference changes.
